t: This is the porters lodge at University College School in Camden, a small gatehouse at the school's entrance. It was designed by Arnold Bidlake Mitchell, an English architect who lived from 1864 to 1944. Mitchell was born in Clapton, in what was then Middlesex and is now part of London, and he established his career in the city at a young age. So this modest gatehouse is the work of a Londoner who built his professional life here.
